items.text: The deadline stands: Monday, 11:59 pm UTC (6:59 pm Eastern). ARC Prize says it is working with Kaggle on the slowdowns.
NVIDIA's CPMP calls the weekend a circus on X, quoting our no-extension report.
Walter Reade of Kaggle says the platform carries two to three times its old load since the ARC contests launched.
Jeroen Cottaar says every submission loses about forty minutes before it starts. CPMP says startup delays are nothing new.
Tufa Labs leads ARC-2 at 88.06 and Yi-Chia Chen leads ARC-3 at 75.56. NVIDIA's nvbanana is third in ARC-2 and NVARC3 is eighth in ARC-3.
